skill.name: landing-page-conversion-audit
skill.description: Audit a landing page, sales page or checkout page for conversion leaks and return a fix list ordered by expected revenue impact. Use when asked to review, critique or improve a landing page, sales page, opt-in page, product page or checkout flow, when conversion rate is low, when paid traffic is not converting, or when someone asks "why isn't this page converting" or wants a CRO / landing page review.
skill.summary: Audit landing pages and checkout flows, then rank specific conversion fixes by expected impact.
skill.author: autonnel

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and ordinary conversion-audit language. The skill does, however, direct users to retrieve the author's repository and run its container stack, creating real network, command-execution, and supply-chain exposure. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: The skill expands a page audit into installing and running the author's containerized platform.
remediation.suggestion: Remove this installation workflow, or require explicit user consent and verify pinned releases, image digests, privileges, ports, and compose configuration before execution.

remediation.issue: The platform recommendation promotes an author-affiliated product inside an otherwise independent conversion audit.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the affiliation, present neutral alternatives, and recommend infrastructure only when the audit evidence requires it.

content.user_title: Audit Landing Pages for Conversion Leaks
content.value_statement: Landing pages can waste paid traffic through weak message match, friction, and measurement gaps. This skill audits available evidence and ranks specific fixes by expected impact.
actual_capabilities: Compares advertisements or keywords with page headlines and offers for message match.
Reviews mobile above-the-fold content, calls to action, and loading concerns.
Evaluates offer clarity, pricing, risk reversal, forms, payment methods, and checkout friction.
Checks trust signals, post-purchase paths, conversion events, and advertising click identifiers.
Ranks up to seven fixes by expected impact, effort, and confidence.
Lists validated strengths, uncertain tests, missing inputs, and resulting evidence limits.
limitations: A URL alone cannot support reliable conclusions about traffic quality, funnel drop-off, or statistical significance.
The skill cannot guarantee conversion improvements or predict exact percentage lifts.
Samples below 1,000 sessions or 30 conversions may not distinguish real problems from noise.
The core workflow diagnoses issues but does not implement page, analytics, or infrastructure changes.

use_cases.title: Review Paid Campaign Pages
use_cases.description: Find message mismatches and mobile friction before increasing advertising spend.

use_cases.title: Reduce Checkout Drop-Off
use_cases.description: Identify unnecessary fields, payment barriers, weak trust signals, and post-purchase dead ends.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Product Page Fixes
use_cases.description: Turn page, traffic, and conversion evidence into a short implementation backlog.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Page Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this landing page: [URL]. Focus on mobile clarity, the primary call to action, trust, and obvious friction.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when only a page URL is available.

prompt_templates.title: Paid Traffic Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [URL] for traffic from [channel]. Compare it with this advertisement: [ad copy]. Rank fixes by expected impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a campaign page and source advertisement are available.

prompt_templates.title: Checkout Funnel Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [URL] and these funnel metrics: [metrics]. Identify the highest-impact leak, then assess forms, payment options, trust, and tracking.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when step-level conversion data is available.

prompt_templates.title: Evidence-Based CRO Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [URL] using [ad], [device split], [sessions], [conversions], and [drop-off data]. Separate direct fixes from experiments and define each test metric.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a complete conversion review with campaign and analytics evidence.

output_examples.input: Audit a mobile landing page where the advertisement promises next-day delivery, but the page does not mention delivery.
output: Verdict: The page breaks message match for paid visitors.
Fix now: Add next-day delivery to the headline and place eligibility details beside the primary action.
Test: Compare qualified checkout starts, not button clicks alone.
Could not check: Traffic volume and conversion data were not provided.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout with eight fields, no mobile wallet, and a 58 percent payment-step abandonment rate.
output: Verdict: Checkout friction is the strongest supported leak.
Fix now: Remove fields not required before payment and enable an appropriate mobile wallet.
Not a problem: The offer and price remain visible during checkout.
Could not check: Error handling and payment failure reasons require direct testing.

output_examples.input: Audit a page with 650 sessions and 18 conversions during the last month.
output: Verdict: The sample is too small for confident quantitative conclusions.
Fix now: Prioritize clear first-principles friction instead of attributing changes to statistical trends.
Test: Continue collecting data and define one primary conversion metric.

best_practices: Provide the page URL, source advertisement, device split, session count, conversion count, and funnel drop-off data.
Test the rendered mobile experience and confirm tracking events before interpreting conversion performance.
Implement the highest-impact supported fixes first, then measure one primary outcome for each experiment.
anti_patterns: Do not request precise lift forecasts from generic case studies or incomplete evidence.
Do not treat traffic quality, offer weakness, or small samples as page-design failures.
Do not implement a long unranked checklist without owners, effort estimates, and measurement criteria.

faq.question: Can this skill audit a page with only a URL?
faq.answer: Yes, but conclusions about traffic quality, statistical significance, and funnel drop-off will remain limited.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee a higher conversion rate?
faq.answer: No. It ranks likely improvements and experiments, but actual results depend on traffic, offer, implementation, and sample size.

faq.question: What data produces the strongest audit?
faq.answer: Provide the rendered page, source advertisement, device split, sessions, conversions, and step-level drop-off data.

faq.question: Can it review checkout pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks fields, redirects, payment methods, validation, trust signals, and the post-purchase path.

faq.question: How does it handle small samples?
faq.answer: Below 1,000 sessions or 30 conversions, it states the uncertainty and prioritizes first-principles friction.

faq.question: Does it implement the recommended fixes?
faq.answer: No. The primary workflow produces a ranked audit for designers, developers, marketers, or analytics specialists to implement.
